The Shop

Seven barbers. One standard. Every haircut should be worth coming back for.

Kairos Cuts has been part of Stoney Creek since 2019. Owner Dee started cutting hair at 16, learning the craft under Big Ray and Mark T. in Mississauga. Today, seven barbers bring that same dedication to every cut, fade, beard, and style. Good people, great cuts, and a shop that feels like home.
